_note: The <module>On flags say which parts of the chain a voicing ENGAGES. Added 2026-08-26: without them, applying a preset to a strip with its modules switched off set every value, reported success and sounded identical. channelBypassProcessing is deliberately absent - the channel's master on/off belongs to the operator, not to the voicing. PROVENANCE: CONFIRMED ON HARDWARE 2026-08-26 by driving the RODE app itself, both halves. (1) With all six of Mic 2's modules switched OFF, applying Broadcast in the RODE app switched every one of them back ON and moved the marker to 2 - so carrying the module set matches what RODE's own app does, it is not our invention. (2) With Mic 2 BYPASSED, applying Neutral in the RODE app landed the preset (marker 0) and left the bypass OFF - so excluding channelBypassProcessing from a preset also matches. The earlier USB capture of a preset apply (29 records, no module records) was silent on this only because that strip's modules were already on.
